cards.name: Move
cards.text: Move one stack to an adjacent empty hex.

cards.name: Basic Attack
cards.text: One stack attacks an adjacent enemy stack.

cards.name: Hold
cards.text: One stack digs in: +1 defense until your next turn.

cards.name: Double Offensive
cards.text: Two different stacks may each attack.

cards.name: Entrench
cards.text: Add a trench chip (+1 defense, max 2) to a stack's hex.

cards.name: Defensive Posture
cards.text: All your stacks get +1 defense until your next turn.

cards.name: Merge
cards.text: Merge a stack into an adjacent friendly stack.

cards.name: Split
cards.text: Send half of a stack (2+ men) to an adjacent empty hex.

cards.name: Rally
cards.text: A stack with fewer than 2 gear gains 1 gear.

cards.name: Propaganda
cards.text: Your resolve improves: -3 on your break score.

cards.name: Martial Law
cards.text: -3 on your break score, but a stack (2+ men) loses 1 man.
